function coronaFor(THREE, def): Texture<unknown, TextureEventMap> | undefined;

Defined in: experiments/star-field/engine/bodies/procedural/corona.ts:88

Generates a seeded star-corona sprite — the "alive" layer that turns a lit disc into a sun: a warm photosphere glow, seeded radial streamers at uneven lengths, and a few flare knots. The sprite rotates slowly in updateFx so the streamers shimmer.

THREE

The three.js module.

Star def (color = streamer tint, id = seed).
